Dragon’s Treasure Logic

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Two-clue logic

A splash and a shape — follow both clues to the one treasure chest that matches.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · TWO-CLUE LOGIC

Dragon’s Treasure Logic

Two clues point to one chest! Find the chest with the right color AND the right shape.

A blue splash and a pink heart. Which chest matches both clues?

A purple splash and a yellow star. Which chest matches both clues?

A red splash and a green circle. Which chest matches both clues?

Treasures found!

Every chest matched both its clues.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains two-clue logic on the puzzle picture itself: the question is spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to explain the rule out loud — saying the “why” is the whole skill.

Illustration note: In the printed sheet every answer chest happens to sit at position B. The game deals the chests in mixed order so children match the clues, not the middle spot.

Prefer paper? The Dragon’s Treasure Logic worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
